Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity

Enum Class MonsterType

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<MonsterType>
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.entity.MonsterType
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<MonsterType>, Constable
public enum MonsterType extends Enum<MonsterType>
The monster roster. Each zone of the Halls has its own theme: the Undercroft is infested with bugs, the Clockwork Stacks are haunted by data-structure and concurrency horrors, and the Ember Vaults are patrolled by the creatures of the cyber-security wars.

Columns: name, glyph, color, HP, accuracy, evasion, damage range, armor, action cost (100 = normal speed, lower is faster), experience, depth range, spawn weight, traits, damage type, on-hit effect (type, percent, duration, magnitude), ranged reach, description.
